entities.name: Taíno Genocide and the Encomienda System
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: The Spanish imposed the encomienda and repartimiento systems of forced labor, combined with European diseases (smallpox, measles, typhus), causing catastrophic demographic collapse. The Taíno population fell from hundreds of thousands to near extinction within fifty years.
